_comment: Ceilings and baseline consumed by verify-deploy.sh Gate 20 (orchestrator context budget lock). Two per-file ceilings are fixed PATH.md targets (not headroom-derived from measured_bytes, unlike claudemd-size-budget.json's formula) -- commands/orchestrate.md is intentionally recorded as currently OVER its ceiling; the gate ships warn-tier for per-file ceilings until that gap closes. eager_load.baseline_bytes is a fixed historical record (2026-09-02) copied verbatim from the task description that introduced this gate -- re-measure with 'REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) bash scripts/measure-eager-context.sh --check' and re-derive only baseline_bytes deliberately (it is the regression ceiling, not a rolling target); measured_bytes/measured_at fields are informational snapshots and may be refreshed freely.

skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md.derivation: PATH.md 'Budgets' target ceiling; currently under ceiling (16,025 B measured via wc -c).

commands/orchestrate.md.derivation: PATH.md 'Budgets' target ceiling; currently OVER ceiling by roughly 2x (15,812 B measured via wc -c). Ships warn-tier (see ORCHESTRATOR_BUDGET_GATE_MODE in verify-deploy.sh) until a future trim brings this file at or under 8,000 B -- this gap is a recorded Stage C follow-up, not a defect in the gate.

eager_load.note: Regression check fails ABOVE baseline_bytes (via 'REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) bash scripts/measure-eager-context.sh --check', parsing the 'TOTAL: <bytes> B' line). baseline_bytes is a fixed recorded ceiling and must never be silently re-derived from a fresh measurement -- only a deliberate, reviewed change should move it. Deliberately bumped from 64450 to 65950 (2026-09-18, focus-prompt/forced-phase/cycle-budget documentation-consistency task): merge-sources/claudemd.md's `/orchestrate` command-table row (predicted-assembled into CLAUDE.md, hence eagerly loaded) grew to document three corrected behaviors -- the per-run work-cycle budget contract (no more `--continue-budget`), artifact-keyed forced plan/implement admission, and the `$2+` user-focus-string threading into dispatched agents' `User focus:` blocks -- growing the eager total from 64,394 B to 65,889 B measured. The new baseline carries a small (~61 B) margin above the measured total rather than pinning it exactly, consistent with the prior baseline/measured gap.
